app.name: create-vue
app.one_liner: The recommended way to start a Vite-powered Vue project.

screens.name: Project Setup CLI
screens.purpose: Guide users through interactive prompts or accept CLI flags to configure a new Vue project.
primary_actions: Run scaffolding command with or without feature flags

rust_commands.name: scaffold_vue_project
rust_commands.purpose: Generate a new Vue 3 project structure based on user-selected features (e.g., TypeScript, Router).

mvp_plan: week 1: Implement core CLI scaffolding logic with Vite-based template generation
week 1: Support feature flags for TypeScript, Router, and minimal boilerplate
acceptance_tests: Omitting @latest results in a warning about potential outdated package resolution.
Running `npm create vue@latest -- --typescript --router` creates a project with both TypeScript and Vue Router configured.
